objective: Compact shared app density, Home/Wall/Connect/Profile, plus photographed Cluster/QMP/Bible/Referral/Character screens for consolidated staging OTA QA.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main 63ccd4b58ff02ff3c1535a1e05d3097fa8323c61 read as latest canonical base; this is source evidence only, not verified installed client or live production.
chosenApproach: Use compact shared visual/DB defaults and targeted high-traffic component changes; natural note height plus bottom-aligned avatars; forward-only diff guard in existing Engineering Regression Gate.
selectionRationale: Blanket global zero padding would break touch and system safe areas. Content-intrinsic note rails and shared tokens reduce whitespace while minimizing regression risk.
alternativeApproaches: Zero every padding/margin universally: unsafe for touch, ads, keyboard, zoom, media and safe areas.
Patch only screenshots: leaves future screens without repeatable standards.
Change shared tokens, targeted note rails and use CI guard (selected).
preserveBehaviors: Maintain all five tabs, links, dark/light text scaling, live calls, ads, media, caching and bottom insets.
Preserve five-line status notes and note editing/read/seen state.
Do not modify DB/RLS/auth/financial/points data or production app.
acceptanceChecks: New shared defaults are coherent while button/input minimum heights remain unchanged.
Wall/Connect note rails are content-sized, bottom-aligned and 5-line compatible.
Home/Profile/Wall/Connect dense changes retain sponsor and first-view AdMob inventory.
Changed focused tests and legacy test expectations pass in PR CI.
Expo/Android visual acceptance, performance and full regression must pass before any OTA. Not verified yet.
Cluster AdMob first-view slot remains after first cluster, other sponsor and viewability contracts remain.
QMP data, referral code, Bible audio, per-character progress, art dimensions and safe areas preserved.
Visual/compiled Android RC verification still mandatory; source-only tests are not an OTA release.
Existing dark contrast test follows approved compact spacing tokens while preserving WCAG contrast and 48dp touch assertions.
